Siphon_Gland_Rudder_Tail.description: The Siphon_Gland_Rudder_Tail is a sleek, muscular appendage ending in a bioluminescent, webbed fin that pulses with an eerie glow, capable of rapid, precise movements that allow for swift directional changes and bursts of speed through water.

Ink_Sac_Mantle_Tail.description: The Ink Sac Mantle Tail is a sinuous appendage, its surface covered in soft, leathery bumps that conceal hidden pouches filled with rich, dark ink. When threatened, it can expel a dense cloud of ink, momentarily shrouding the wielder in a cloak of obscurity, enhancing their stealth.

Pointed_Torpedo_Tail.description: The Pointed_Torpedo_Tail is a sleek, elongated appendage that undulates with an eerie grace, its segmented body mimicking the swift, silent movements of a deep-sea predator, enhancing the wielder's agility and speed as they dart and sprint with the fluidity of a cephalopod slicing through ink-black waters.

Bioluminescent_Lure_Tail.description: The Bioluminescent_Lure_Tail is a mesmerizing appendage, glowing with an otherworldly light that pulsates in mesmerizing patterns, drawing creatures closer with its hypnotic allure. Its texture is slick and cool to the touch, capable of emitting a paralyzing glow when threatened or hunting.

Venomous_Spine_Tail.description: The Venomous Spine Tail is a serpentine appendage, adorned with rows of sharp, translucent spines that shimmer with a sickly blue glow, each one filled with a potent neurotoxin capable of paralyzing prey. Its texture is slick and cool to the touch, and when wielded, it lashes out with deadly precision, granting its bearer a swift and deadly advantage in combat.

Anchor_Peduncle_Tail.description: The Anchor_Peduncle_Tail is a thick, muscular appendage tapering from a broad base to a sharp, pointed tip, covered in a layer of sticky, rubbery suckers that can grip any surface with unyielding force, granting both stability and the ability to adhere to walls and ceilings.

Whip_Lash_Tail.description: The Whip_Lash_Tail is a sinuous appendage, resembling a cephalopod's tentacle with sharp, segmented ridges that pulse with an eerie bioluminescence, capable of striking with the force and precision of a whip, extending the wielder's reach by two meters.

Electric_Discharge_Tail.description: The Electric_Discharge_Tail is a serpentine appendage, resembling a bioluminescent tentacle with iridescent scales that crackle with a sizzling, blue-white energy. When wielded, it extends the user's reach and allows for devastating, electrically charged melee strikes.

Spiral_Nautiloid_Tail.description: The Spiral_Nautiloid_Tail is a sinuous appendage, coiled tightly like the ancient chambers of a nautiloid's shell, granting its bearer both the deceptive grace and defensive resilience of the deep-sea cephalopod, enhancing their agility and constitution.

Rudder_Mantle_Flap.description: The Rudder_Mantle_Flap is a sinuous, bioluminescent appendage that undulates gracefully like a living shadow, its surface rippling with intricate patterns as it shifts and moves to steer with unparalleled precision.

Membrane_Cloak_Tail.description: The Membrane_Cloak_Tail is a sinuous appendage, its surface covered in iridescent, bioluminescent scales that can shift color and pattern to perfectly match the surroundings, granting the user unparalleled concealment in dark, underwater environments.

Vestigial_Stub_Process.description: The vestigial stub process, a small, fleshy nub that emerges from the lower back, pulsates subtly with each heartbeat, hinting at a forgotten cephalopod ancestry. Its surface is slick and cool to the touch, occasionally releasing a faint, phosphorescent glow.
